strategy.summary: Two tests regressed since 0610e02. formatPrice now shows '12.50 USD' on purpose (26dcac5, PR #99, changelog 1.1.0), so its test is updated to the new format. shippingFor(5000) now charges 499 because the refactor in 28e7c8e (PR #99) uses `subtotal > b.over` where the old code used `>= FREE_SHIPPING_FROM`; the commit says no change to what anyone pays, so this is a real regression: the test is kept, marked it.fails, recorded and filed.
inScope: test/money.test.js › formatPrice formats a price in dollars
outOfScope: Changing application source (src/shipping.js fix is the app owner's)
assumptions: formatPrice's default currency is USD, so formatPrice(1250) is intended to return '12.50 USD' per CHANGELOG 1.1.0 and the commit message.
FREE_SHIPPING_FROM (5000, 'this much or more ships free') still documents the intended rule; the RATES refactor was meant to be behaviour-preserving.
Existing tests change only as far as the outcome needs: one expected value in money.test.js, and it.fails plus a comment in shipping.test.js; no other restructuring.

risks.description: Exactly-$50 orders are charged $4.99 shipping in production
risks.mitigation: TC2 stays asserting 0, marked it.fails so it turns red when fixed; issue filed. The neighbouring 'ships free above $50' and 'flat rate under $50' tests still pass normally, so it.fails is not the only check on shipping.

acceptanceCriteria.text: formatPrice shows a price in cents with its ISO currency code after the amount, USD by default (1250 -> '12.50 USD').
Orders whose goods cost 5000 cents or more ship free (shippingFor(5000) is 0).

culprit.subject: Show prices with their currency code
culprit.body: Finance asked for the ISO currency code on every price we show (12.50 USD rather than $12.50), so invoices read the same in every market. This is the new format on purpose; the changelog says so.
culprit.author: TestForge eval
culprit.diff:
diff --git a/CHANGELOG.md b/CHANGELOG.md
index 69aa252..a3b2055 100644
--- a/CHANGELOG.md
+++ b/CHANGELOG.md
@@ -1,5 +1,10 @@
 # Changelog
 
+## 1.1.0
+
+- Prices are shown with their ISO currency code after the amount (`12.50 USD`, no longer `$12.50`), so
+  invoices read the same in every market. `formatPrice` takes the currency as its second argument.
+
 ## 1.0.0
 
 - Price an order's lines and its shipping, and format prices for display.
diff --git a/src/money.js b/src/money.js
index ed28740..40cc5fd 100644
--- a/src/money.js
+++ b/src/money.js
@@ -1,5 +1,5 @@
-/** A price in cents as customers see it, such as `$12.50`. */
-export function formatPrice(cents) {
+/** A price in cents as customers see it, with its currency code: `12.50 USD`. */
+export function formatPrice(cents, currency = 'USD') {
   if (!Number.isInteger(cents) || cents < 0) throw new RangeError(`Not a price in cents: ${cents}`);
-  return `$${(cents / 100).toFixed(2)}`;
+  return `${(cents / 100).toFixed(2)} ${currency}`;
 }
